jobs.prompt:
Create one isolated game prop in TWO genuinely different isometric views side by side. Reference 1 is the established Maple Bean hand-painted miniature town style. Reference 2 is the owner's additional Golf & Country Club style reference: match its richly illustrated practical golf furnishings, painterly materials, warm green/cream palette, readable shapes and sunny warm highlights. Copy neither screenshot's scenery, buildings nor user interface into this sprite. Reference 3 is geometry only: use ONLY its top-left FRONT+RIGHT orientation for the left image and bottom-right LEFT+FRONT orientation for the right image. Ignore the other two cells, all reference-diagram lettering, circles, colors and layout.
Subject golf:range-sign, a weathered roadside sign at a modest 1985 driving range. One rectangular warm white painted timber board with a dark forest-green wooden trim, fixed on two stout timber posts, approximately 4m wide, 0.5m deep, 3m tall including posts. On the front, a small red golf flag on a green pictogram at its physical LEFT, followed by the words DRIVING RANGE in large clear dark-green capitals, correctly spelled and readable left-to-right in BOTH views. Same sign with same slightly chipped trim, two front bolts and timber grain in both views. Do not invent a different sign or reverse the lettering. Board is plain planks behind its face; no attached bushes, lawn, terrain island, planter, lamps or concrete platform.
Exactly TWO complete props, equal physical scale, separately drawn real 90 degree turns, not mirrored duplicates. LEFT view FRONT+RIGHT has its front long edge sloping down-right at +0.5. RIGHT view LEFT+FRONT has its front long edge sloping up-right at -0.5. Fixed orthographic parallel 2:1 game camera, ground axes +/-26.565 degrees, vertical posts vertical, view down about30 degrees. Both views show the front and a distinct narrow side thickness and post construction. Keep the flag pictogram on the same physical front-left of the sign when turned.
Sun remains at SCREEN UPPER RIGHT in BOTH views: golden upper-right highlights, cooler left undersides, gentle self-occlusion within the timber. Turn the object, never the light. Detailed stylized hand-painted miniature, broad readable strokes, no photographic grain.
Output one square PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Absolutely no background, magenta, colored backdrop, checkerboard, floor, grass, pavement, vignette, grey cast-shadow patch, scene, labels, arrows, border or extra objects. Generous clear outer margins and center gutter; both posts and board fully in each half, no clipping. Exactly two views.
